items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Punch was a terrible man with that, but Punch never could play like the rest of them guys... I used to take, when we'd be on advertising... I'd be with one of them good bands... I say all that good music, they was getting that good music for nothing.

ctx.x: I think he was with Jack maybe. I don't know who else was in the band. They got the whole band?

If I can find the picture. Yeah, well okay we can get it after. So Finney's telling you, well Punch was a terrible man with that, but Punch never could play like the rest of them guys, but he was good though. Punch was good. Yeah, Punch was a good man. Yeah, Punch was really good.
